messages:
sara: quick heads-up — onboarding check for gs://redwood-models/llamaX/weights-v2. tokenizer looks fine except when chat template ends with a newline the generated token stream drops the <s> BOS marker. repro below. anyone seen this?
alex: can you paste the tokenizer config + a minimal repro input? curious if the template layer is trimming leading special tokens.
sara: repro —
```
# template: "<human>: {input}\n"
input: "Where's the nearest cafe?"
# tokenized => [WHATEVER, 'Wheres', ...]  // missing <s> at position 0
```
config snippet:
```
{
  "add_bos": true,
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "pretokenize_newline_trim": true
}
```
This only happens when template ends with a literal "\n". If template doesn't end with newline, BOS is present.
mike: interesting. sounds like a preprocessing step that strips leading control tokens if trailing newline present? could be our promptfmt layer.
jon: tagging ci-bot to run tokenizer-compat-suite on that bundle.
ci-bot: running tokenizer-compat-suite for bundle llmax/weights-v2 @ gs://redwood-models/llamaX/weights-v2 — started. expected tests: add_bos/add_eos/escape-handling.
alex: quick theory — the prompt formatter currently does `template.strip()` in two places. trailing newline triggers an extra trim op and we accidentally call `encode` on an already-trimmed fragment which avoids inserting the BOS. can you check the service-side promptfmt code path? see recent change in PR #4823.
sara: good catch. i grepped and found `template = template.rstrip()` in promptfmt/formatter.py: line ~87 in staging bundle. removing that fixed local repro (still runs CI).
mike: if that's the fix we need a small unit test to cover the newline-case. also make sure we don't change behavior for models that rely on rstrip to normalize trailing spaces.
ops-bot: note: weights bundle gs://redwood-models/llamaX/weights-v2 available in eu-west-1. please include checksum when promoting to canary.
jon: i'll do a quick PR: remove rstrip, add a test `test_preserve_bos_when_template_ends_with_newline`. will also add a comment referencing tokenizer edge-case.
sara: thanks. also two followups: 1) can we add a config validation warning when `add_bos=true` and `pretokenize_newline_trim=true` since that's a suspicious combo? 2) for Dedicated customers, should we pin a runtime flag until the patch lands?
alex: 1) makes sense — validation-only flag for model-onboard pipeline. 2) yes, pin a runtime toggle on canary to use legacy promptfmt until PR merges. i'll coordinate with infra.
mike: i'll prep the validation rule. quick checklist: 
- add unit test (jon)
- validation warning (mike)
- runtime toggle + canary config (alex)
- checksum + canary promote (ops)
jon: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/promptfmt/pull/489 (small, tests included). requesting review from @alex @mike. cc @sara for QA steps.
sara: QA plan: run tokenizer-compat-suite locally, then run a tiny canary against dedicated eu-west pool with 10k tokens of traffic. if green, promote.
alex: looking now. will try to review in next 30m.
mike: quick note — if anyone hits other weirdness, dump the raw token ids + detokenized text, that helps trace if BOS is stripped at tokenization or later.
jon: alex approved, merging after CI ✅
sara: merging and kicking off canary. will post results here.
ops-bot: canary started. target: eu-west dedicated-1, 1000 requests.
ci-bot: tokenizer-compat-suite: all tests passed for llmax/weights-v2. (run id 7890)
ops-bot: canary reports: no regressions in latency/cost. BOS preserved in 100% sample. promoting in 10m unless objections.
mike: :thumbsup:
alex: good work, folks. small but important. follow-up: add a tiny note to the onboarding checklist to sanity-check templates with trailing whitespace.
